mods.name: FMod
mods.description: Stash hunting, route and flight helpers, coordinate hiding, and utilities for Meteor Client.

releases.notes:
FMod 0.2.0 is a **prerelease for Minecraft 26.3 and Meteor Client 26.3**. It is a different feature set from the legacy v1.1.1 release.

## Changes

- Ported FMod to Minecraft/Meteor 26.3, Java 25, and the current Mojang-named APIs.
- Added 18 stashhunting modules and the Weather and EntityList HUD elements from the stashhunting addon: stash detection and exports, old-chunk alerts, trail following and plotting, rectangle/spiral searches, flight helpers, inventory indexing, and utility modules.
- Added `coord-hider` for F3 location entries, Meteor coordinate HUD templates, and coordinate text.
- Removed TpMine, LiveWalk, InstaMine, InfReach, FrozenWalk, and their dedicated hooks and HUD. Teleport and clip commands remain available.
- Added bounded background webhook delivery and fixed several startup, path-mode ownership, and inventory-response issues in the port.
- Set GPL-3.0-only as FMod's primary license, retained attribution and provenance notices, and refreshed the documentation and logo.

## Install

1. Use **Minecraft 26.3**, **Meteor Client for 26.3**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer**, and **Java 25 or newer**.
2. Download **`fmod-0.2.0.jar`** below and place it alongside Meteor in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Open Meteor's menu and select the **FMod** category. Commands use Meteor's configured prefix (`.` by default).

Map and trail integrations require the corresponding optional Xaero and/or Meteor Baritone mods. These mods are not bundled. See [optional dependencies and tested versions](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.2.0/docs/FEATURES.md#optional-mods).

## Validation and limitations

- Built from a clean checkout; all 5 unit tests passed.
- The actual packaged JAR passed startup and runtime assertions with optional mods absent and with Xaero's maps, XaeroPlus, and Baritone installed.
- Multiplayer gameplay and server-specific exploits have **not** been verified; this is a prerelease, not a guarantee of compatibility with a particular server.
- Coordinate hiding affects on-screen text only. Maps, world geometry, packets, exports, logs, clipboard contents, and configured webhook messages can retain real coordinates. Unrecognised third-party overlay/text formats can also remain visible.
- The imported stashhunting revision has no published license file. FMod's GPL declaration does not resolve that upstream permission issue. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.2.0/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for provenance and redistribution limitations.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the SHA-256 checksum for the JAR. Source for this release is available through the `v0.2.0` tag and GitHub's source archives below.
